comparison.objective: Stow canisters according to hazard level and required containment rings; candidate removes manufactured insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Semantic classification, upright placement, and pocket insertion versus coaxial mandrel alignment, hammering, and tiny metal-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Each canister upright in an individually suitable containment location; candidate requires four tang fractures and containment with every insert and the shell intact.
comparison.reason: Containment-level sorting tests a different ability and outcome despite both tasks penalizing unsafe placement. Numeric upright tolerances are unavailable.
